comments.text: Hello dear, just one query. We are also quarantining in South Palm right now and heading to Jeddah from here. Out flight is on 7th August at night. I just want to ask how many hours in advance you need to check out from the resort to go to Male airport as it took us a long time to come here from Male airport to island (had to stop at Gan airport in middle), first from seaplane then by speedboat. So will it take the same time to return to Male airport again? And the resort will provide the airport transfer service at the required time? This is my main point of concern as we are just two ladies traveling and confused on this. Thank you ❤️
comments.author: @miraclespyer

comments.text: Also if we have taken just one dose of Covishield vaccine, do we still need to upload on Eservices website?

comments.text: @miraclespyer  One dose not required to upload as needs to have quarantine in Jeddah and make sure to book it from Saudia holidays website before 4 days otherwise system will not allow you to book within 4 days of departure

comments.text: @HappyHomeHappyAll  yes , we already have Saudi airlines institutional quarantine package booked in Jeddah hotel. Just want to make sure our timing match so we do not miss the flight from Male to Jeddah

comments.text:
Hello dear yes that’s the issue as the flight from Male to Jeddah is at 10pm and from Gan airport to Male airport when we came we checked out from resort at 3am in the morning but at that time flight departure was at 5pm.
As there was only one flight from Gan to Male and you can try the online website of Maldivian airlines.
And if there are no other flight then you have to do the early checkout and at Male you can arrange a hotel till evening to stay because if you will leave at 3am then you will reach Male at 8am and till 7pm you have to stay outside the airport area and in our case we stayed at domestic lounge at the domestic airport
comments.author: @HappyHomeHappyAll

comments.text: @HappyHomeHappyAll  yes, same our flight is the same one at 10pm. Your flight from Gan to Male was available in only one time slot of 5pm? Because we too booked through travel agents so when we arrived, the people from South Palm met us at the airport and connected us through Gan and got the tickets for us and the transport. But we have no idea how to do all this if we want to go back to Male airport :(
